title: Trapped as the Villain in My Favorite Dating SIM Manga Ends
content: Square Enix 's Manga UP! service published on Wednesday the eighth and final part of the final chapter of writer Kennoji and artist Yūma Yun 's Trapped as the Villain in My Favorite Dating SIM: But I Know How to Win Over All the Heroines!
author: ANN

title: Sega Announces Sonic Live in Concert Global Tour
content: Sega announced on Wednesday the Sonic Live In Concert global tour for the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise, which will run in the U.S. and the U.K. from September 20, 2026-February 20, 2027. The company will announce other European stops at a later date.
author: ANN

content: Disney+ just brought back one of its long lost Disney animated shows to the streaming service after decades of being missing , and there are many others that still need to make their own comebacks.

title: Aloha Comics Adds Ikuno Tajima's Ever After Manga in English
content: Comic publisher Aloha Comics announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Monday that it will release Ikuno Tajima 's After Märchen manga in English under the title Ever After as its first manga license. The company will release the two-volume series in hardcover copies with bonus merchandise.
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Shares First Look at Final Manga Release After Finale
content: Black Clover officially came to an end after 11 years with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine, and is getting ready for its final manga volume with the first look at its release.

title: Brigandine: Abyss Game Launches Playable Demo
content: NIS America revealed in a new trailer on Monday a playable demo available now for Brigandine: Abyss , a new title in Happinet 's Brigandine strategy game series, on PC via Steam . The game is getting a a Deluxe Edition for Switch 2 and PS5, and it includes a mini art book and digital soundtrack.
